clue.text: International initiative to get trial on the move?

parts.note: an international cricket or rugby match is a Test
drive is energy and initiative

explanation.surface: A global scheme to stage a trial, perhaps one that travels from place to place.
explanation.walkthrough: A Test is an international cricket match, a sense common in Britain.
explanation.definitionFit: A test drive is a trial of a car carried out while it is being driven.

clue.text: Vehicle in trading centre heading north

indicators.note: in a down clue, going north means the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a mart is a market, a centre for trading

explanation.surface: A vehicle runs through a busy commercial district, travelling northwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A tram is a passenger vehicle running on rails in the street.

clue.text: Am captivated by newly-made Saint's endurance

indicators.note: to be captivated by something is to be held inside it, so the word Am goes within the other piece
something newly made has been formed afresh, so the letters of the word are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to being enthralled by a freshly canonised saint's staying power.
explanation.walkthrough: 'newly-made' gives STINA, and 'captivated by' means the first word sits within it; the possessive 's is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Stamina is the physical or mental strength to keep going, which is endurance.

clue.text: Daughter in from France finds secluded room

parts.note: en is the French word for in

explanation.surface: A girl back from France discovers a private room tucked away.
explanation.definitionFit: A den is a small private room where someone retreats to work or relax.

clue.text: Following sequence from popular performance

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
a turn is an act or performance on stage

explanation.surface: A running order taken from a well-loved show.
explanation.definitionFit: To do things in turn is to take them one after another, in order.

clue.text: In Cowes, plan a delightful walk

indicators.note: the answer lies in the run of letters spanning these words

explanation.surface: A tip for visitors to Cowes: arrange a pleasant stroll.
explanation.walkthrough: Cowes is a sailing town on the Isle of Wight, off England's south coast.
explanation.definitionFit: An esplanade is a level public promenade, typically along a seafront, made for walking.

clue.text: Dorothy's brief point

definitions.meaning: The short form of the name Dorothy

explanation.surface: Dorothy gets straight to the matter in hand.
explanation.definitionFit: Dot is a familiar pet name for Dorothy, and also a tiny spot or mark.

clue.text: Move gradually away — ultimately sad breach

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the following word

parts.note: a rift is a break or breach between people

explanation.surface: Friends slowly separate, and in the end a sorry rupture follows.
explanation.definitionFit: To drift apart is to separate slowly, without any sudden break.

clue.text: Seat flung in the air, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the word sounds like the answer when spoken

parts.note: something flung upwards has been thrown

explanation.surface: A chair tossed up high, apparently.
explanation.definitionFit: A throne is a ceremonial chair, the seat of a monarch.

clue.text: Opposed to once more going to street

parts.note: again means once more

explanation.surface: Someone objects to heading out on the road yet again.
explanation.definitionFit: Being against something is being in opposition to it.

clue.text: Previous religious head

definitions.meaning: the head of a priory or religious house

explanation.definitionFit: Prior is both an adjective for earlier and a title for a monastery's superior.

clue.text: Darn green kit needing repair for school

indicators.note: something needing repair must be fixed and reassembled, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Mend the green sports kit that needs fixing before school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needing repair' signals rearranging DARN GREEN KIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A kindergarten is a nursery school for very young children.

clue.text: Discourage fellow cleaner

parts.note: to deter is to discourage
a gent is a man or fellow

explanation.surface: Put off the man who comes to clean.
explanation.definitionFit: Detergent is a cleansing agent used for washing.

clue.text: By the sound of it, worked in education, far from relaxed

indicators.note: this phrase says the word is to be heard, giving the answer as it is pronounced

parts.note: a teacher taught, working in education

explanation.surface: A former teacher sounds anything but laid back.
explanation.definitionFit: Taut means stretched tight or tense, the opposite of relaxed.

clue.text: Mountains are lovely places, scenic first of all

indicators.note: first of all takes the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: Mountains are lovely, scenic places, a travel brochure line.
explanation.definitionFit: The Alps are the great mountain range of central Europe.

clue.text: Glass accommodating a church's style

indicators.note: a thing accommodating others holds them inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a pane is a sheet of window glass

explanation.surface: A window that shows off a church's architectural flair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accommodating' signals that the window piece holds the rest; the 's is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Panache is flamboyant confidence of manner, stylish flair.

clue.text: Challenge air conditioning price

parts.note: cost means price

explanation.surface: Someone disputes what the air conditioning will cost.
explanation.definitionFit: To accost someone is to approach and confront them boldly.

clue.text: Boss overseeing ten in workshop

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece overseeing another sits above it, so it comes first

parts.note: a boss is a raised stud or knob
IO looks like the figures 10, ten

explanation.surface: The manager supervises ten people in a workshop.
explanation.walkthrough: A boss is also a decorative knob or stud, not a manager.
explanation.definitionFit: A studio is an artist's or craftsman's workroom.

clue.text: Get decent air for a change after disposing of this?

definitions.text: Get decent air for a change after disposing of this?

indicators.note: a change here means the letters are switched round into a new order

explanation.surface: Breathe some fresh air for once after stubbing out a smoke.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for a change' rearranges GET DECENT AIR, and the whole clue describes the butt: throw it away and the air gets cleaner.
explanation.definitionFit: A cigarette end is the stub left after smoking, whose disposal means cleaner air.

clue.text: Dirt, unpleasant, at bottom of scuttle

parts.note: grim means unpleasant or bleak

indicators.note: in a down clue, the bottom of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: Nasty soot lies at the bottom of the coal scuttle.
explanation.walkthrough: A scuttle is a bucket for carrying coal.
explanation.definitionFit: Grime is ingrained dirt or soot.

clue.text: Those remaining take it easy

explanation.surface: The people left behind should relax.
explanation.definitionFit: Rest names both the remainder of a group and the act of relaxing.

clue.text: Fruit, round, as it happens

parts.note: O is round in shape
a live broadcast is shown as it happens

explanation.surface: A round fruit, as it turns out.
explanation.definitionFit: An olive is the small oily fruit of the olive tree.

clue.text: Reverse taxi into printer's sign? Disaster!

indicators.note: into means the piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: dele is the proofreader's mark meaning delete

indicators.note: reverse tells us to read the word backwards

parts.note: a cab is a taxi

explanation.surface: A cab backs into a signwriter's board: what a fiasco!
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reverse' and 'into' are the indicators; dele is the proofreader's margin mark telling the printer to delete something.
explanation.definitionFit: A debacle is a sudden, humiliating failure, a fiasco.

clue.text: Prohibition of financial institution? Not entirely

indicators.note: not entirely means the word lacks its last letter

parts.note: a bank is a financial institution

explanation.surface: Is a bank's embargo only partly in force?
explanation.definitionFit: A ban is an official prohibition.

clue.text: Extract from southern article

indicators.note: an extract is a piece taken out of the word that follows

explanation.surface: An excerpt taken from a southern newspaper piece.
explanation.definitionFit: The is the definite article in grammar.

clue.text: Nth sortie amazingly and the most difficult?

indicators.note: something done amazingly is thrown into confusion, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A pilot's umpteenth mission, remarkably, is the hardest yet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'amazingly' rearranges NTH SORTIE; the question mark flags thorny as a figurative sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Thorny means prickly and, figuratively, tricky, so thorniest is hardest.
